bias.zh: 反弹 · 跌破 5 日和 10 日均线

read.en: Marvell fell 4.7% on Nov 13 to $156.76, trading $149.17–163.89. It is below the 5-day ($159.8, rising), 10-day ($157.7), 30-day ($217.9), 100-day ($225.5) and 200-day ($187.0, rising); the 10, 30 and 100-day are falling. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12, below zero, histogram narrowing; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 29 ($178.43), and RSI is 35.2.
read.zh: Marvell 11月13日下跌 4.7%，收于 $156.76，盘中区间 $149.17–163.89。股价位于 5 日（$159.8，上行）、10 日（$157.7）、30 日（$217.9）、100 日（$225.5）和 200 日均线（$187.0，上行）下方；10 日、30 日和 100 日均线在下行。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，在零轴下方，柱状图收窄；抛物线 SAR 自 10月29日起看空（$178.43），RSI 为 35.2。

read.en: The drop broke the $162.9 Jul 29 low and the 5 and 10-day, now resistance; the $149.17 low held. Resistance is $157.7–159.8 (Nov 9 high, 10 and 5-day), then $162.9–164.5 (Jul 29 low, Nov 12 close) and $168.8–169.6. Support is $154.4–156 (Nov 9–10 closes, Nov 12 low), then $146.9–149.2 and $141.2 (Nov 6 close). A close above $159.8 would target $163–164.5; below $154.4, $147–149.
